sentences.text: In short: JA HANDEL AS is a young small company in "detaljhandel med bredt vareutvalg med hovedvekt på nærings- og nytelsesmidler" based in Holmestrand, profitable in 2025 and with no open NAV job ads under its org number.
JA HANDEL AS is registered in the industry "Detaljhandel med bredt vareutvalg med hovedvekt på nærings- og nytelsesmidler"; its registered activity is "Butikkhandel med dagligvare.".
JA HANDEL AS is a private limited company (AS), founded on 2023-01-27, registered in Holmestrand.
It has 18 registered employees, reported revenue of NOK 73.92M for 2025 and an operating result of NOK 1.05M (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show an operating margin of 1.4% and a moderate equity ratio of 16% of total assets.

Revenue rose 4.2% from 2024 to 2025 (NOK 70.94M to NOK 73.92M); it was NOK 48.12M in 2023. The annual result was a profit in each of the 3 filed years read (2023: NOK 35,103, 2024: NOK 679,193, 2025: NOK 874,649).
JA HANDEL AS is led by Judith Almås, who is both CEO and board chair.
The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2024-08-01.
JA HANDEL AS has 1 registered workplace.
